summary:
Iteration 9 — CENTRO OPERATIVO PULIZIE Admin (6-tab restructure + Zones/Rioni + multi-cleaner assign + route-order + operational_zone_id on structures). BACKEND pytest 9/9 PASS in 8.13s (/app/backend/tests/test_cleaning_ops_center.py). Verified: (a) GET /api/zones returns >=35 zones ordered by 'order' with last one 'Altro / Da definire'; cleaner role → 403; include_inactive=true includes deactivated zones. (b) POST /api/zones creates; PUT /api/zones/{id} renames + toggles active (deactivated zones excluded from default list); PUT /api/zones/reorder correctly updates the 'order' field. (c) PUT /api/structures/{id} with operational_zone_id persists and GET returns it; cleaning tasks of that structure carry zone_id + zone_name='Cavana' in the enrichment (GET /api/cleaning-tasks). (d) POST /api/cleaning-tasks/{id}/assign — first assign: unassigned→assigned + notification, cleaner_id in assigned_cleaner_ids. Idempotent: second identical assign leaves cleaner_ids unchanged (count=1). Second assign of a DIFFERENT cleaner → assigned_cleaner_ids has BOTH ids on the SAME record (no duplicate task in /cleaning-tasks). DELETE /assign/{cleaner_id} removes ONLY that cleaner; when last cleaner removed status returns to unassigned; the corresponding route_order.{cleaner_id} key is $unset. (e) PUT /api/cleaning-tasks/route-order {cleaner_id, ordered_task_ids} persists route_order.{cleaner_id}=index on each task (verified via GET). (f) Regression: bed_max validation → 400 with 'massimo'; portal /me for client role works (200/404, no 500).

FRONTEND (Admin desktop 1920px /cleaning) verified: All 6 tabs present (data-testid cleaning-tab-days/organize/today/calendar/all/issues). GIORNATE controls (giornate-prev/next/date-input/today-btn — today-btn correctly hidden when date == today, shown when different date). day-summary shows 'N pulizie · N assegnate · N da assegnare · N completate' (correct for 2026-09-02: '2 pulizie·2 assegnate·0 da assegnare·0 completate'). view-mode-list/cleaner/zone all present; Per Rione renders grouped-by-zone container with 'Cavana' visible; new-cleaning-btn opens cleaning-form-drawer with structure-search-input; searching 'KLV-0002' returns 1 structure-result-*; selection precompiles the drawer; checkin-yes-btn, more-options-toggle, save-task-btn all present. ORGANIZZAZIONE: org-master-list, cleaner-column-{id} (2 cleaners MARIA BIANCHI + ANNA ADDETTA), org-filter-unassigned all present. OGGI: kpi-todo/inprogress/completed/problems + today-zone-filter + today-cleaner-filter present. CALENDARIO: cal-prev/cal-next/cal-zone-filter present. TUTTE: all-search-input + all-status-filter present; searching 'KLV-0002' filters correctly. IMPOSTAZIONI: zones-settings-card visible with zone-new-input + zone-add-btn.

BOTH viewports covered where the feature is applicable. Cleaner regression + client portal verified via API (no 500). DND drag&drop was NOT UI-tested (Playwright HTML5 dnd is unreliable in headless) but the underlying assign / unassign / route-order APIs used by the drop handlers are 100% covered by pytest.
action_items: OPTIONAL: expose an admin-only DELETE /api/zones/{id} for hard-deleting unused zones (currently the workflow keeps deactivated zones forever; my tests deactivate & rename with prefix TEST_deleted for cleanup, which leaves cruft in the collection).

OPTIONAL: consider adding data-testid to per-cleaner subgroup wrappers in GroupedByCleaner (currently only the outer grouped-by-cleaner container and group-unassigned have testids; individual cleaner subgroups have no testid, which makes per-cleaner assertions harder). Non-blocking — CompactTaskRow rows are still uniquely selectable.
OPTIONAL (carried from iter_8): align frontend todayStr() to Europe/Rome to avoid browser-TZ drift when comparing with backend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_zone (line ~1183) does not distinguish inactive+empty-name from a rename to empty string — silently ignores empty name. Consider returning 400 explicitly if data.name is provided as empty. Minor.

server.py assign_cleaner_to_task: on idempotent second-assign it returns enriched task WITHOUT sending an updated_at bump — acceptable (no-op), but consider also skipping the notification creation on idempotent path (currently the early return DOES skip the notification, which is correct).
server.py set_cleaner_route_order iterates PUT with N update_one calls in a loop — for large routes consider bulk_write. Not critical (routes are small).
OperationalZones: no unique constraint on 'name' — two zones with the same name can co-exist. Add a case-insensitive uniqueness check in create_zone if desired.
DayView.jsx GroupedByCleaner: cleaner subgroup <div> lacks a data-testid (e.g. group-cleaner-{id}); tests must fall back to text matching.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the testable UI controls (drag&drop deferred to manual verification)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: 2 TEST_ zones created, deactivated + renamed 'TEST_deleted' at cleanup; 3 cleaning tasks (TEST_ops_center + 2x TEST_route_A/B) created & deleted; 1 structure update (Appartamento Centro operational_zone_id=Cavana zone id) — Cavana was already set in the fixture so no persistent change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suites reusable: /app/backend/tests/test_cleaning_module_v2.py + test_cleaning_fixes_v3.py + test_cleaning_ops_center.py (all self-cleaning). Zones collection accumulates TEST_deleted entries over runs since there's no DELETE endpoint; ignore or add hard-delete if this becomes noisy. HTML5 drag&drop UI tests were skipped — the equivalent APIs (assign/unassign/route-order) are already covered by pytest. Structure KLV-0002 Appartamento Centro is the canonical test fixture (operational_zone_id=Cavana, bed_config double=2 single=2 sofa=1). BASE_URL loader in the new test falls back to /app/frontend/.env when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is unset in the shell env (pytest under supervisor).
